ad_account_id.description: Meta ad account (with or without act_). Required when creating a new audience.

audience_id.description: Append to this existing customer-list audience instead of creating one.

customer_file_source.description: Where the list came from (Meta-required). Default USER_PROVIDED_ONLY.

default_country_code.description: Dialing code added to phones without one, e.g. '52' for Mexico.

email.description: Email address. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

phone.description: Phone; include the country code or set default_country_code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

first_name.description: First name. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

last_name.description: Last name. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

city.description: City. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

state.description: State / province code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

zip.description: Postal code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

external_id.description: Your CRM id for this person. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed (64 hex).

members.description: People to add. Hashed server-side; uploaded in batches of 10,000.

idempotency_key.description: Caller operation id; an exact retry replays the receipt.

mode.description: 'preview' summarizes + returns a confirm_token; 'confirm' sends to Meta.

dataset_id.description: Meta pixel / dataset id that receives the events.

event_name.description: Standard (Purchase, Lead, CompleteRegistration, Subscribe…) or custom name. Offline sign-ups ("altas") are usually CompleteRegistration or Subscribe.

event_time.description: Unix seconds or ISO-8601. ≤7 days old (≤62 days for physical_store), not in the future.

event_id.description: Dedup key (match your pixel event_id). Derived from the event when omitted.

currency.description: ISO-4217, e.g. MXN. Required with value.

em.description: Email. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

ph.description: Phone; include country code or set default_country_code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

external_id.description: Your CRM / customer id. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

fn.description: First name. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

ln.description: Last name. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

ct.description: City. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

st.description: State / province code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

zp.description: Postal code. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country. Raw or already SHA-256 hashed; hashed server-side.

default_country_code.description: Dialing code added to phones without one, e.g. '52' for Mexico.

test_event_code.description: Events Manager test code: events show in Test Events and do not count.

value.description: Money fields (spent, cpa…) are in the account currency minor units: 10000 = 100.00.

filters.description: Must include entity_type and time_preset; e.g. spent GREATER_THAN 50000.

execution_type.description: PAUSE stops the matching entities; NOTIFICATION only alerts.

execution_options.description: e.g. { field: 'user_ids', value: ['<fb user id>'], operator: 'EQUAL' } for who gets notified.

status.description: Default ENABLED (needs admin approval); DISABLED creates it switched off.

amount_micros.description: The new DAILY budget, in micros.

id.description: Campaign / ad group ID; for ad_group_ad, '<ad_group_id>~<ad_id>'.

search_partners.description: Also serve on Search partners. Default false.

params.description: That action's params WITHOUT mode/confirm_token — the batch sets them.

ops.description: Executed in order at confirm; the first failure stops the rest.

tool.description: Backing tool name prefix to filter, e.g. paid_entity_update. Default: all paid_*

max_daily_budget_minor.description: Max daily budget per entity in minor units (cents); null removes the cap.

max_increase_pct.description: Max budget increase per change without admin approval (default 30).
